page: Microsoft Azure PB6s is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the PBS server family. It runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and features an x86_64 Intel processor with 6 dedicated virtual CPUs. The instance is configured with 112.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 18.67 GB per vCPU.

For local storage, the PB6s includes a 754 GB solid-state drive (SSD) and is designated as Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance storage options. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this instance. The server does not feature any graphics processing units (GPUs), making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated rendering or deep learning workloads.

Given the high memory density relative to the 6 dedicated vCPUs, this server type offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that require significant RAM capacity without needing massive parallel CPU compute. The combination of 112.0 GB of RAM and local SSD storage makes the PB6s suitable for memory-intensive applications, small to medium database hosting, caching layers, and enterprise applications requiring dedicated CPU allocation and Premium Storage compatibility.
